ex.en: Copying from the internet without citing sources is plagiarism.
ex.zh: 從網路上抄東西而不註明出處就是抄襲。

ex.en: The student was punished for plagiarism.
ex.zh: 那個學生因為抄襲而受到處分。

plagiarism.en: the act of using someone else's work and saying it is your own

ex.en: Our wedding planner took care of everything.
ex.zh: 我們的婚禮顧問把一切都打理好了。

ex.en: She works as an event planner.
ex.zh: 她是活動企劃。

planner.en: a person whose job is to organize and plan events or projects

ex.en: I write all my deadlines in my planner.
ex.zh: 我把所有截止日期都寫在記事本裡。

ex.en: Do you use a paper planner or an app?
ex.zh: 你用紙本行事曆還是 App？

planner.en: a book or app where you write your plans and things to do

ex.en: That sounds like a plausible explanation.
ex.zh: 這聽起來是個合理的解釋。

ex.en: His excuse was plausible, so we believed him.
ex.zh: 他的藉口聽起來合理，所以我們相信了他。

plausible.en: likely to be true or reasonable

ex.en: Have you pulled the plug out?
ex.zh: 你把插頭拔掉了嗎？

ex.en: The plug doesn't fit the outlet.
ex.zh: 這個插頭插不進插座。

plug.en: a plastic object at the end of a wire that connects a machine to electricity

ex.en: Is the power cord plugged into a power outlet?
ex.zh: 電源線有插到插座上嗎？

ex.en: Plug in your laptop before the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會前先把筆電插上電源。

plug.en: to connect a machine to the electricity supply

ex.en: Plug your nose.
ex.zh: 把鼻子捏住。

ex.en: We need to plug the leak quickly.
ex.zh: 我們得趕快把漏洞堵住。

plug.en: to fill a hole or gap so that nothing can get through

ex.en: The placement of the furniture makes the room look bigger.
ex.zh: 家具的擺放方式讓房間看起來更大。

ex.en: Product placement is common in movies.
ex.zh: 置入性行銷在電影裡很常見。

placement.en: the act of putting something in a particular position, or that position

ex.en: She got a placement at a law firm.
ex.zh: 她被安排到一家律師事務所實習。

ex.en: Students take a placement test before the course starts.
ex.zh: 學生在開課前要先參加分班測驗。

placement.en: the act of finding a job, training place, or class for someone

ex.en: I am plowing my land.
ex.zh: 我正在犁田。

ex.en: The farmer plowed the field before planting.
ex.zh: 農夫在播種前先犁田。

plow.en: to turn over the soil of a field with a farm machine before planting

plow.zh: plow through：費力地完成、埋頭處理

ex.en: I plowed through a pile of emails this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上埋頭處理了一大堆電子郵件。

ex.en: She plowed through the report before the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在開會前硬是把報告看完了。

plow.en: to work through a large amount of something with great effort

ex.en: The plaintiff is asking for one million dollars in damages.
ex.zh: 原告要求一百萬元的損害賠償。

ex.en: The court ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
ex.zh: 法院判原告勝訴。

plaintiff.en: a person who brings a case against someone in a court of law

ex.en: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
ex.zh: 聯邦、州與地方官員立即承諾會重建它。

ex.en: I pledge allegiance to the flag.
ex.zh: 我宣誓效忠國旗。

ex.en: The company pledged to cut emissions by half.
ex.zh: 公司承諾要把排放量減半。

pledge.en: to promise seriously to do or give something

ex.en: The mayor made a pledge to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 市長承諾要降稅。

ex.en: We received pledges of over one million dollars.
ex.zh: 我們收到超過一百萬元的認捐。

pledge.en: a serious promise to do or give something

ex.en: Stock prices plunged to a record low.
ex.zh: 股價跌到歷史新低。

ex.en: Sales plunged after the scandal.
ex.zh: 醜聞爆發後銷售暴跌。

plunge.en: to fall quickly and by a large amount

ex.en: He plunged into the lake fully clothed.
ex.zh: 他連衣服都沒脫就跳進湖裡。

ex.en: We plunged into the river.
ex.zh: 我們跳進了河裡。

plunge.en: to jump or fall into something, or to put something into something suddenly

plunge.zh: take the plunge：毅然決定、鼓起勇氣去做

ex.en: He finally took the plunge and started his own business.
ex.zh: 他終於下定決心自己創業。

ex.en: We took the plunge and bought a house.
ex.zh: 我們鼓起勇氣買了房子。

plunge.en: to decide to do something important or risky after thinking about it for a long time

ex.en: She pleaded with her boss for more time.
ex.zh: 她懇求老闆多給她一些時間。

ex.en: He pleaded for help.
ex.zh: 他懇求協助。

plead.en: to ask for something in a strong and emotional way

ex.en: He pleaded guilty to the charge.
ex.zh: 他對這項指控認罪。

ex.en: She pleaded not guilty in court.
ex.zh: 她在法庭上表示不認罪。

plead.en: to say in a court whether you did a crime or not

ex.en: Many of Europe's metropolises are plagued by the donut phenomenon.
ex.zh: 許多歐洲大都市都飽受「甜甜圈現象」困擾。

ex.en: The project has been plagued by delays.
ex.zh: 這個專案一直受延誤所苦。

plague.en: to cause trouble or suffering to someone again and again

ex.en: The plague spread quickly through the city.
ex.zh: 瘟疫在城裡迅速蔓延。

ex.en: A plague of locusts destroyed the crops.
ex.zh: 一大群蝗蟲毀了農作物。

plague.en: a disease that spreads quickly and kills many people, or a large number of harmful things

plague.zh: avoid ... like the plague：像躲瘟疫一樣避開

ex.en: She avoided him like the plague.
ex.zh: 她像躲瘟疫一樣避開他。

ex.en: I avoid crowded malls like the plague.
ex.zh: 我對人擠人的商場避之唯恐不及。

plague.en: to stay away from someone or something as much as you can

ex.en: She was plainly upset about the decision.
ex.zh: 她顯然對這個決定很不高興。

ex.en: The instructions are plainly written on the box.
ex.zh: 使用說明清楚地寫在盒子上。

plainly.en: in a way that is easy to see or understand

ex.en: To put it plainly, we can't afford it.
ex.zh: 說白了，我們負擔不起。

ex.en: He spoke plainly about the company's problems.
ex.zh: 他坦白地談到公司的問題。

plainly.en: in an honest and direct way

ex.en: There are a lot of beautiful places in Japan.
ex.zh: 日本有很多美麗的地方。

ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
ex.zh: 你應該把貴重物品放在安全的地方。

ex.en: Tell me about some of the places you've visited.
ex.zh: 跟我說說你去過的一些地方。

ex.en: As usual, he placed the key on the table.
ex.zh: 他照例把鑰匙放在桌上。

ex.en: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.
ex.zh: 把撲克牌放在橡木桌上。

place.en: to put something carefully in a particular position

ex.en: I'd like to place an order for 50 units.
ex.zh: 我想訂購五十件。

ex.en: We placed the order last Monday.
ex.zh: 我們上週一下了訂單。

place.en: to ask a company officially to supply goods

ex.en: The meeting will take place on Friday.
ex.zh: 會議將在星期五舉行。

ex.en: The wedding took place in a small church.
ex.zh: 婚禮在一間小教堂舉行。

ex.en: It's a rainy day, so we can't play outside.
ex.zh: 今天下雨，我們不能到外面玩。

ex.en: The kids are playing in the park.
ex.zh: 孩子們在公園裡玩。

play.en: to have fun by doing activities or games

ex.en: He plays golf two or three times a month.
ex.zh: 他一個月打兩、三次高爾夫。

ex.en: We played basketball after work.
ex.zh: 我們下班後去打籃球。

play.en: to take part in a sport or game

ex.en: Entering the room, I found her playing the piano.
ex.zh: 我進房間時，看到她正在彈鋼琴。

ex.en: Can you play the guitar?
ex.zh: 你會彈吉他嗎？

play.en: to make music with an instrument

ex.en: Play the video again, please.
ex.zh: 請再播一次影片。

ex.en: The radio was playing my favorite song.
ex.zh: 收音機正在播我最喜歡的歌。

play.en: to make a recording produce sound or pictures

ex.en: We saw a play at the National Theater.
ex.zh: 我們在國家戲劇院看了一齣戲。

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote many plays.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞寫了很多劇本。

play.en: a story written to be acted on a stage

ex.en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
ex.zh: 如果你發現錯誤，請幫忙改正。

ex.en: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
ex.zh: 請告訴我怎麼去機場。

ex.en: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
ex.zh: 請告訴我們哪裡有雜貨店。

please.en: used to make a request or an order more polite

ex.en: It's impossible to please everyone.
ex.zh: 不可能讓每個人都滿意。

ex.en: She is very hard to please.
ex.zh: 她很難取悅。

please.en: to make someone feel happy or satisfied

please.zh: be pleased with / to：對…滿意；很高興…

ex.en: Well, Bill, I am pleased to see you here.
ex.zh: 嗯，比爾，很高興在這裡見到你。

ex.en: I'm very pleased with the flowers you gave me.
ex.zh: 你送我的花我很喜歡。

ex.en: He does not seem pleased with his condition.
ex.zh: 他似乎對自己的狀況不太滿意。

please.en: to feel happy or satisfied about something

ex.en: You are a good tennis player, as beginners go.
ex.zh: 以初學者來說，你網球打得不錯。

ex.en: My son wants to become a professional golf player.
ex.zh: 我兒子想成為職業高爾夫球選手。

ex.en: We have no chance against those top players.
ex.zh: 我們沒機會贏那些頂尖選手。

player.en: a person who takes part in a game or sport

ex.en: The company is a major player in the smartphone market.
ex.zh: 這家公司是智慧型手機市場的主要業者。

ex.en: Only a few big players control the industry.
ex.zh: 只有少數幾家大業者控制這個產業。

player.en: a company or person that has an important part in a business area

ex.en: Five plus three is eight.
ex.zh: 五加三等於八。

ex.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
ex.zh: 他的薪酬包括底薪加上佣金。

plus.en: used to show that one number or thing is added to another

ex.en: Waterproof features would be a plus.
ex.zh: 有防水功能的話會是加分。

ex.en: Speaking Japanese is a big plus for this job.
ex.zh: 會說日文對這份工作是一大加分。

plus.en: an extra good point that makes something better

ex.en: Our plane took off exactly on time at six.
ex.zh: 我們的飛機在六點整準時起飛。

ex.en: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
ex.zh: 飛機開始震動時，乘客都緊張了起來。

ex.en: My hobby is making model planes.
ex.zh: 我的嗜好是做模型飛機。

plane.en: a vehicle with wings and engines that flies in the air

ex.en: Few things give us as much pleasure as music.
ex.zh: 很少有東西能像音樂一樣帶給我們這麼多快樂。

ex.en: Reading is one of life's great pleasures.
ex.zh: 閱讀是人生一大樂事。

ex.en: One of my pleasures is watching TV.
ex.zh: 看電視是我的樂趣之一。

pleasure.en: a feeling of happiness and enjoyment

ex.en: Did you go abroad for pleasure or on business?
ex.zh: 你出國是去玩還是出差？

ex.en: I read mostly for pleasure.
ex.zh: 我看書主要是為了消遣。

pleasure.en: enjoyment or fun, not work or duty

pleasure.zh: It's a pleasure / My pleasure：很榮幸；不客氣

ex.en: It's a pleasure to meet you.
ex.zh: 很高興認識你。

ex.en: "Thanks for your help." "My pleasure."
ex.zh: 「謝謝你的幫忙。」「不客氣。」

pleasure.en: a polite thing to say when you are happy to meet or help someone

ex.en: There's no need to panic. There's plenty of time.
ex.zh: 別慌，時間還很多。

ex.en: Don't worry. We have plenty of water and food.
ex.zh: 別擔心，我們有充足的水和食物。

ex.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.
ex.zh: 醫生堅持病人要充分休息。

plenty.en: a large amount that is enough or more than enough

ex.en: The plates are still wet because I just washed them.
ex.zh: 這些盤子我剛洗過，所以還是濕的。

ex.en: There was a single potato chip on each plate.
ex.zh: 每個盤子上都有一片洋芋片。

ex.en: Here are the glasses, the plates and the serviettes.
ex.zh: 這裡有玻璃杯、盤子和餐巾。

plate.en: a flat round dish that you put food on

ex.en: Did you get the car's license plate number?
ex.zh: 你有記下那輛車的車牌號碼嗎？

ex.en: The machine is covered with steel plates.
ex.zh: 這台機器外面包覆著鋼板。

plate.en: a flat piece of metal, such as the one with numbers on a car

ex.en: Paper, glass and plastic are recyclable materials.
ex.zh: 紙、玻璃和塑膠都是可回收的材料。

ex.en: These boxes are made of plastic.
ex.zh: 這些箱子是塑膠做的。

ex.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
ex.zh: 塑膠已取代了許多傳統材料。

plastic.en: a light strong material made by chemicals and used to make many things

ex.en: No thank you, I don't need a plastic bag.
ex.zh: 不用了，謝謝，我不需要塑膠袋。

ex.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
ex.zh: 塑膠盤子放在爐子上會融化。

plastic.en: made of a light strong material made by chemicals

ex.en: The movie has a very simple plot.
ex.zh: 這部電影的情節很簡單。

ex.en: I won't tell you the plot of the book.
ex.zh: 我不會告訴你這本書的情節。

plot.en: the series of events that make up a story

ex.en: They accused him of being part of the plot.
ex.zh: 他們指控他參與了這起陰謀。

ex.en: Police uncovered a plot to steal the paintings.
ex.zh: 警方破獲了一起偷畫的陰謀。

plot.en: a secret plan made by a group to do something bad

ex.en: They bought a small plot of land to build a house.
ex.zh: 他們買了一小塊地蓋房子。

ex.en: She grows vegetables on a small plot behind her house.
ex.zh: 她在屋後的一小塊地上種菜。

plot.en: a small piece of land used for a special purpose

ex.en: Could you say that in plain English?
ex.zh: 你可以用淺白的英文再說一次嗎？

ex.en: He made a speech in plain English.
ex.zh: 他用淺顯的英文發表演說。

ex.en: Could you put it in plain language?
ex.zh: 你可以說得簡單明白一點嗎？

plain.zh: 樸素的、普通的；（食物）清淡的

ex.en: We are used to eating plain food.
ex.zh: 我們吃慣了清淡的食物。

ex.en: I'm just a plain old office worker.
ex.zh: 我只是個平凡的上班族。

ex.en: She wore a plain white T-shirt.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件素面白T恤。

plain.en: simple, with nothing added or special

ex.en: The waterways branch out across the plain.
ex.zh: 水道在平原上分支延伸。

ex.en: The city lies on a wide plain.
ex.zh: 這座城市位於一片寬廣的平原上。

plain.en: a large area of flat land

ex.en: How many planets are there in the solar system?
ex.zh: 太陽系有幾顆行星？

ex.en: The earth is not a star, but a planet.
ex.zh: 地球不是恆星，而是行星。

ex.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
ex.zh: 木星是太陽系中最大的行星。

planet.en: a large round object in space that moves around a star

ex.en: His voice is pleasant to listen to.
ex.zh: 他的聲音很悅耳。

ex.en: I wish you a pleasant voyage.
ex.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。

ex.en: I had a pleasant dream last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚做了一個好夢。

ex.en: The family owns a large coffee plantation.
ex.zh: 這個家族擁有一座大型咖啡園。

ex.en: Tea plantations cover the hills of the region.
ex.zh: 這個地區的山坡上遍布茶園。

plantation.en: a large farm where crops such as tea, coffee, or sugar are grown

ex.en: What is the plural of 'child'?
ex.zh: 「child」的複數是什麼？

ex.en: The word 'news' has no plural.
ex.zh: 「news」這個字沒有複數形。

plural.en: the form of a word that shows more than one

ex.en: The plural form of "louse" is "lice".
ex.zh: 「louse」的複數形是「lice」。

ex.en: Use a plural verb with 'people'.
ex.zh: 「people」要搭配複數動詞。

plural.en: showing more than one person or thing

ex.en: This thing can't be rushed; it needs long-term planning.
ex.zh: 這件事不能急，需要長期規劃。

ex.en: He is an expert in the area of city planning.
ex.zh: 他是都市計畫領域的專家。

ex.en: Good planning is the key to a successful event.
ex.zh: 良好的規劃是活動成功的關鍵。

planning.en: the process of thinking about and deciding what to do in the future

ex.en: She assumed that everyone would be for the plan.
ex.zh: 她以為每個人都會贊成這個計畫。

ex.en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
ex.zh: 你週末有什麼計畫嗎？

plan.en: a set of ideas about how to do something in the future

ex.en: They planned to get together here at 7 o'clock.
ex.zh: 他們約好七點在這裡碰面。

ex.en: Tom didn't say where he was planning to go.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒說他打算去哪裡。

plan.en: to decide what you will do and how you will do it

ex.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
ex.zh: 大多數的保險方案都不給付整形手術。

ex.en: I switched to a cheaper phone plan.
ex.zh: 我換了一個比較便宜的手機方案。

plan.en: an arrangement of services you can choose and pay for

ex.en: We need to call a plumber. The sink is blocked.
ex.zh: 我們得叫水電工，水槽塞住了。

ex.en: The plumber fixed the leak in an hour.
ex.zh: 水電工一小時就把漏水修好了。

plumber.en: a person whose job is to fit and repair water pipes

ex.en: Well, Bill, I am pleased to see you here.
ex.zh: 呃，比爾，我很高興在這裡見到你。

ex.en: I'm very pleased with the flowers you gave me.
ex.zh: 我很滿意你送我的花。

ex.en: They were pleased at the birth of their first child.
ex.zh: 他們第一個孩子出生了，很高興。

ex.en: The workers made a plea for better working conditions.
ex.zh: 工人們懇求改善工作環境。

ex.en: Her plea for help was ignored.
ex.zh: 她的求救沒有人理會。

plea.en: a strong and emotional request for help or something you need

plea.zh: （法律上的）答辯、認罪與否的聲明

ex.en: He entered a plea of not guilty.
ex.zh: 他提出無罪答辯。

ex.en: The court accepted her guilty plea.
ex.zh: 法院接受了她的認罪答辯。

plea.en: a statement made in court saying whether you did a crime or not

ex.en: Tibet sits on a high plateau.
ex.zh: 西藏位於高原上。

ex.en: The town is on a plateau 1,500 meters above sea level.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮位在海拔一千五百公尺的高原上。

plateau.en: a large area of high flat land

ex.en: My weight loss has hit a plateau.
ex.zh: 我的減重進入了停滯期。

ex.en: Sales reached a plateau after the first year.
ex.zh: 第一年過後，銷售量就停滯不前了。

plateau.en: a period when there is no change or progress

ex.en: We found many strange plants in a botanical garden.
ex.zh: 我們在一家植物園裡找到了許多稀奇古怪的植物。

ex.en: "What are you doing?" "I'm watching my plants grow."
ex.zh: 「幹嘛呢？」「在看我養的植物生長呢。」

ex.en: We observed this plant closely for a few weeks.
ex.zh: 我們仔細觀察這株植物好幾個星期了。

plant.en: a living thing that grows in soil and has leaves and roots

ex.en: Many workers were laid off at that plant.
ex.zh: 那家工廠裁掉了很多工人。

ex.en: The car company is building a new plant in Mexico.
ex.zh: 這家汽車公司正在墨西哥蓋新工廠。

plant.en: a factory or a large building where power or goods are made

ex.en: Spring is the season for planting trees.
ex.zh: 春天是適合種樹的季節。

ex.en: We planted tomatoes in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在院子裡種了番茄。

plant.en: to put seeds or small young trees or flowers in the ground so they grow

ex.en: The person who planted the bomb hasn't been caught.
ex.zh: 放炸彈的人還沒抓到。

ex.en: Someone planted a camera in the room.
ex.zh: 有人在房間裡偷裝了攝影機。

plant.en: to hide something somewhere, often to cause harm

ex.en: The carpenter cut the plywood to fit the cabinet doors.
ex.zh: 木工把夾板裁切成適合櫥櫃門片的尺寸。

ex.zh: 那座雕像立在一個高高的石製底座上。

ex.en: A small plinth in the museum holds the ancient vase.
ex.zh: 博物館裡一個小底座上擺著那只古老的花瓶。

ex.en: The police arrested the plotter before he could act.
ex.zh: 警方在密謀者採取行動前逮捕了他。

ex.en: The engineer used a plotter to print the large map.
ex.zh: 工程師用繪圖機印出了那張大地圖。

ex.en: They have a platonic friendship and nothing more.
ex.zh: 他們只是純友誼的關係，沒有其他。

ex.en: He kept the relationship strictly platonic.
ex.zh: 他把這段關係維持在純粹朋友的程度。

ex.en: The playback of the recording was very clear.
ex.zh: 那段錄音重播時非常清晰。

ex.en: Press this button to start playback.
ex.zh: 按這個按鈕開始播放。

ex.en: We watched a show about the stars at the planetarium.
ex.zh: 我們在天文館看了一場關於星星的表演。

ex.en: The school took the children to a planetarium on a field trip.
ex.zh: 學校帶孩子們去天文館校外教學。

ex.en: Hand me the pliers so I can pull out this nail.
ex.zh: 把鉗子拿給我，我好把這根釘子拔出來。

ex.en: He used pliers to bend the wire.
ex.zh: 他用鉗子把鐵絲彎曲。

ex.en: There is a pair of pliers in the toolbox.
ex.zh: 工具箱裡有一把鉗子。

ex.en: She wore a blue pleated skirt to school.
ex.zh: 她穿著藍色的百褶裙去上學。

ex.en: The pleated curtains hung neatly beside the window.
ex.zh: 打褶的窗簾整齊地掛在窗邊。

ex.en: We fried ripe plantain slices for dessert.
ex.zh: 我們把熟大蕉片拿去油炸當甜點。

ex.en: Plantain looks like a banana but is usually cooked before eating.
ex.zh: 大蕉看起來像香蕉，但通常要煮熟才吃。

ex.en: Dad built a small wooden playhouse in the backyard.
ex.zh: 爸爸在後院蓋了一間小木造遊戲屋。

ex.en: The children spent all day in the playhouse.
ex.zh: 孩子們整天都待在遊戲屋裡。

ex.en: The old playhouse in town shows new plays every month.
ex.zh: 鎮上的老劇場每個月都上演新戲。

ex.en: We watched a comedy at the local playhouse.
ex.zh: 我們在當地的劇場看了一齣喜劇。

ex.en: The plaintive song made everyone feel sad.
ex.zh: 那首哀怨的歌讓大家都難過起來。

ex.en: The puppy let out a plaintive cry at the door.
ex.zh: 小狗在門邊發出哀怨的叫聲。

ex.en: Use a level to check that the wall is plumb.
ex.zh: 用水平儀檢查牆壁是否垂直。

ex.en: The post stood plumb in the ground.
ex.zh: 那根柱子筆直地立在地上。

ex.en: Divers plumbed the depths of the lake.
ex.zh: 潛水員探測了湖的深處。

ex.en: The book plumbs the mysteries of the human mind.
ex.zh: 這本書探究了人類心靈的奧祕。

ex.en: Whales feed on tiny plankton in the cold sea.
ex.zh: 鯨魚以冷海中微小的浮游生物為食。

ex.en: Plankton is a key part of the ocean food chain.
ex.zh: 浮游生物是海洋食物鏈的重要一環。

ex.en: He was known as a rich playboy who loved fast cars.
ex.zh: 他以愛開跑車的富有花花公子聞名。

ex.en: The movie's hero starts out as a lazy playboy.
ex.zh: 這部電影的主角一開始是個懶散的花花公子。

ex.en: The coach drew a new play in the team's playbook.
ex.zh: 教練在球隊的戰術手冊裡畫了一套新戰術。

ex.en: Startups often follow the same playbook to grow quickly.
ex.zh: 新創公司常照著同一套方法快速成長。

planted.zh: 種植；栽種（plant 的過去式）

ex.en: We planted tomatoes in the garden last spring.
ex.zh: 去年春天我們在花園裡種了番茄。

ex.en: My grandfather planted this tree when he was a boy.
ex.zh: 我爺爺小時候種下了這棵樹。

ex.en: Someone planted a false story in the newspaper.
ex.zh: 有人在報紙上安插了一則假消息。

ex.en: The suspect claimed that the police had planted the evidence.
ex.zh: 嫌疑人聲稱證據是警方栽贓的。

ex.en: He plausibly explained why he was late.
ex.zh: 他很合情合理地解釋了自己為什麼遲到。

ex.en: The story could plausibly be true.
ex.zh: 這個故事有可能是真的。

ex.en: The puppy's playfulness made everyone smile.
ex.zh: 小狗的調皮可愛讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: Her playfulness brightened up the long meeting.
ex.zh: 她的俏皮讓冗長的會議活潑了起來。

ex.en: His speech was full of empty platitudes about hard work.
ex.zh: 他的演講充滿了關於努力的空洞老調。

ex.en: "Time heals all wounds" is a platitude, not a comfort.
ex.zh: 「時間會治癒一切」是句老套話，並不能安慰人。

ex.en: The placenta supplies food and oxygen to the baby.
ex.zh: 胎盤為胎兒提供養分和氧氣。

ex.en: The doctor checked that the placenta was healthy.
ex.zh: 醫生確認胎盤狀況良好。

ex.en: The detective doubted the plausibility of his story.
ex.zh: 偵探懷疑他說法的可信度。

ex.en: Her explanation had a certain plausibility, but I wanted proof.
ex.zh: 她的解釋有幾分道理，但我想要證據。

ex.en: Pluto is now called a dwarf planet.
ex.zh: 冥王星現在被稱為矮行星。

ex.en: Pluto takes a very long time to travel around the Sun.
ex.zh: 冥王星繞太陽一圈要花非常長的時間。

ex.en: The baby's favorite plaything is a soft rubber duck.
ex.zh: 寶寶最喜歡的玩具是一隻軟軟的橡皮鴨。

ex.en: The kitten turned my shoelace into a plaything.
ex.zh: 小貓把我的鞋帶當成了玩具。

ex.en: He felt like a plaything in the hands of the rich.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己像是有錢人手中的玩物。

ex.en: The small boat was a plaything of the waves.
ex.zh: 那艘小船任憑海浪擺布。

ex.en: She wore her hair in a long plait down her back.
ex.zh: 她把頭髮編成一條長辮子垂在背後。

ex.en: The little girl asked her mother for a plait.
ex.zh: 小女孩請媽媽幫她編辮子。

ex.en: Can you plait my hair before the party?
ex.zh: 你可以在派對前幫我編頭髮嗎？

ex.en: They plait straw into baskets by hand.
ex.zh: 他們用手把稻草編成籃子。

ex.en: The kids spent the rainy afternoon in the playroom.
ex.zh: 孩子們在遊戲室度過下雨的午後。

ex.en: There are lots of toys and books in the playroom.
ex.zh: 遊戲室裡有許多玩具和書。

plenary.zh: 全體出席的；全體會議的

ex.en: All members attended the plenary session this morning.
ex.zh: 所有成員都出席了今早的全體會議。

ex.en: The plenary meeting will vote on the new rules.
ex.zh: 全體大會將就新規定進行表決。

ex.en: He plonked his bag on the table and sat down.
ex.zh: 他把包包往桌上一放，坐了下來。

ex.en: She plonked herself on the sofa after work.
ex.zh: 她下班後一屁股坐到沙發上。

ex.en: We only had cheap plonk to serve at the party.
ex.zh: 派對上我們只有便宜的葡萄酒可招待。

ex.en: He bought a bottle of plonk for the picnic.
ex.zh: 他為野餐買了一瓶便宜的葡萄酒。

ex.en: The leather is soft and pliable.
ex.zh: 這塊皮革柔軟又好彎折。

ex.en: Young children are more pliable than adults.
ex.zh: 小孩子比成人更容易受影響。

ex.en: There is plenty of food for everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 派對上的食物多到每個人都夠吃。

ex.en: You should drink plenty of water every day.
ex.zh: 你每天應該多喝水。

ex.en: He has plenty of time to finish the work.
ex.zh: 他有很多時間可以完成工作。

plenty of.en: a large amount of; more than enough

ex.en: Good sleep plays a part in staying healthy.
ex.zh: 充足的睡眠對保持健康有幫助。

ex.en: Many people played a part in making the festival a success.
ex.zh: 許多人都出了力，讓這場慶典辦得成功。

play a part.en: to have an effect on something or to help make it happen

ex.en: My sister plays the piano every evening after dinner.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚飯後都會彈鋼琴。

ex.en: He learned to play the piano when he was six.
ex.zh: 他六歲就學會彈鋼琴。

play the piano.en: to make music using a piano

ex.en: Driving that fast in the rain is playing with fire.
ex.zh: 雨天開那麼快簡直是玩火。

ex.en: Don't play with fire by lying to your parents.
ex.zh: 別玩火，不要對你的父母說謊。

play it cool.zh: 抑制住感情, 做出冷靜的樣子

ex.en: He tried to play it cool when he saw his favorite singer.
ex.zh: 他看到最愛的歌手時，努力裝出冷靜的樣子。

ex.en: Just play it cool and don't let them see you're nervous.
ex.zh: 保持冷靜，別讓他們看出你很緊張。

play it cool.en: to stay calm and hide your excitement or worry

ex.en: I'll play it safe and leave early because of the traffic.
ex.zh: 我要穩一點，因為塞車所以提早出發。

ex.en: Investors who play it safe usually earn less money.
ex.zh: 求穩的投資人通常賺得比較少。

play it safe.en: to avoid risk and act carefully

play the fool.zh: 幹蠢事, 演滑稽角色

ex.en: He likes to play the fool to make his friends laugh.
ex.zh: 他喜歡裝傻逗朋友笑。

ex.en: Stop playing the fool and help me clean up.
ex.zh: 別再鬧了，過來幫我收拾。
